justification: src/generators/feature-matrix.ts emits FEATURE_MATRIX.md, its gate and the rtm-verdict schema into a governed project, and __tests__/generators/feature-matrix.test.ts exercises that emission: 15 cases covering the sentinel block, the status vocabulary, the skipIfExists posture that keeps the matrix user-owned after first write, the gate and schema written alongside it, the emitted gate passing against the matrix the same generator just wrote, and — since #2480 wave 7 — the emitted gate NAMING the dependency it is missing rather than dying on MODULE_NOT_FOUND, and refusing a Verified row with no verification envelope. The suite was executed for this verdict rather than read, and re-executed when wave 7 changed the cited spans: a citation that moves invalidates the verdict it supported, which is what axis 1 reported here rather than something anyone remembered to check.
